jobs.description: Employer: Camp Bear Creek Expires: 12/01/2026 Media Specialist – Summer StaffLocation: Camp Bear Creek – Eastern IowaWebsite: https://bearcreek.camp/current-job-openings/summer-camp/Dates: May 23-July 24, 2027Camp Bear Creek is a Christian summer camp in Eastern Iowa serving kids from kindergarten through 12th grade. We’re looking for passionate, fun, dedicated people who want to spend a summer making a real difference — in the lives of campers and in their own.Come work as a Media Specialist at Camp Bear Creek. We are seeking a talented individual who is ready to put their skills into practice. The Media Specialist for the summer gains a lot of experience in, well, all things media. However, you also have the chance to do a lot more than that. You'll be immersed in the summer camp environment, interacting with children and youth in a Christian setting, learning how to capture their stories and how to share the mission of the camp, the joy of the moment, and the magic of summer in something as simple as a photograph or as complex as a ten minute video.The Media Specialist is responsible for camp photography and videography. You'll be out there with the camera, whether it's a DSLR or the GoPro, capturing that kid's giant smile as they go flying down the slip 'n slide or the moment they make it to the top of the rock wall or their splash landing at the bottom of the mud slide. The Media Specialist maintains the daily summer camp blog, which parents depend on as one of their only sources of communication with their child while they're away for six days at camp. They want to know what it feels like to be at camp even when they can't be there themselves, and the best Media Specialist will be able to help them do that. The Media Specialist updates the camp social media accounts, engaging a diverse community of all ages and experiences that spans back over a 65 year history. The Media Specialist designs a weekly summary video, compiling everything that they have captured during the week and uniquely putting it all together into an 8-10 minute video that parents and campers will not only watch over and over, but they'll want to show others because it so perfectly captures what camp was like.If you think you're ready for a summer like this and to be the Media Specialist, please complete the application through the camp’s website at https://bearcreek.camp/current-job-openings/summer-camp/ You'll walk away from the summer with a bigger portfolio, college credit, and a wealth of experience. Plus, you can't discount the chance to have some fun at camp, either!

jobs.description: Employer: Reporters Without Borders Expires: 12/02/2026 Spring 2027 Internship - Reporters Without Borders USAReporters Without Borders/Reporters sans frontières (RSF), the world’s largest organization devoted to the safety, pluralism, and independence of journalism, is seeking an intern for its Washington, DC office (RSF USA) this fall. About RSF USA RSF USA is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization affiliated with RSF that helps protect press freedom and the right to reliable information in North America, which includes the United States, Canada, and English-speaking Caribbean countries. We also use our position in Washington, DC to work in concert with RSF’s 13 offices around the world to advance our global priorities. Role DescriptionThe internship is ideal for current undergraduate students or recent college graduates who are in the Washington, DC area during the spring and are interested in working in an international nonprofit dedicated to press freedom and the right to reliable information. RSF USA interns contribute to all facets of our work, including advocacy, communications, and fundraising. There may also be flexibility to tailor the intern’s activities to match their background or the practical experience they hope to gain. Specific responsibilities may include but are not limited to: Advocacy:Join frequent advocacy meetings with congressional staff, federal government officials, and NGO partner organizations.Research legislation, court cases, and global press freedom issues.Prepare talking points and Q&A documents on specific issues for meetings with congressional staff.Support urgent RSF actions by working on advocacy strategies across congressional, federal, and state targets.Identify potential partners and champions of RSF USA’s work within the government and learn best practices for building successful coalitions.Build relationships with journalists, lawyers, and NGOs around the country to support the creation of press freedom networks.Represent the RSF DC office in meetings with other RSF offices from around the world.Contribute to advocacy materials like congressional letters and comments to federal agencies.Monitor congressional hearings and help follow up with congressional offices. Communications:Oversee RSF USA’s internal press freedom newsletter by monitoring press freedom issues and sharing updates to RSF’s international staff on a daily basis.Help maintain a list of press contacts and make recommendations for press outreach opportunities. Support the drafting of press releases, social media posts, op-eds, and other written publications.Attend and/or contribute to the planning and execution of press freedom-related events. Fundraising:As needed, minimal assistance with:Building development pipelines through prospect and donor research.Donor record upkeep.Appeals/acquisitions via email and standard mail.Grant applications.Fundraising event support. LogisticsWe will consider applications for both full-time (40 hours per week) and part-time (minimum of 20 hours per week) interns for the spring term, which will start in January and conclude in May. The role operates in a hybrid office environment that requires two in-person work days a week for team collaboration and consistent use of office equipment such as computer, printer, and scanner. Thus, the intern must be residing in the Washington, DC area during the internship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for internship opportunities at this time. In addition, the intern is paid a monthly stipend of $600 for part time and $1,000 for full time. Applicant Qualifications:Interested in press freedom, human rights, journalism and/or international nonprofits.Interested in the US policymaking process.Experience communicating with external stakeholders as part of an organization.Excellent communication (written and verbal).Developed research skills, including finding original sources, compiling data in impactful ways, and tailoring outputs for different audiences.Agility in task management, from long-term projects to breaking news responses.An eye for creative solutions to entrenched problems.Familiarity with using various software programs at other organizations.Strong time management.Media literate and an avid news consumer.Able to work in-person in Washington, DC during the summer per our hybrid (in-office/remote) schedule.Detail-oriented.Proactive.Reliable.Native-level English proficiency.French language skills not required, but a plus. Application InstructionsRSF USA welcomes current undergraduate students or recent college graduates that meet the qualifications to apply for this opportunity. We do not recommend that current postgraduate students or recent postgraduates apply. Those interested in applying should submit their 1) resume and 2) cover letter that includes your anticipated weekly availability this spring. To be considered for this opportunity, all applicants must submit their resume and cover letter as a single, combined PDF to hiring@rsf.org by December 1st, 2026 with “RSF Spring 2027 Internship” as the subject line. Reporters Without Borders is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any applicants for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, caste, national origin, citizenship, immigration status, veteran status, disability; or on any other basis prohibited by law.

Expires: 12/03/2026 Category Manager Intern (TikTok Shop - Operations) - 2027 Summer (MBA)Location: Los AngelesEmployment Type: InternJob Code: A85012BAbout the TeamThe commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the commerce channel of choice for merchants, creators, and affiliates. You've seen the virality and impact of #TikTokMadeMeBuyIt. Come join the team that is helping scale that phenomenon, and pioneer Content & Creator commerce in the US. We aim to bring discovery, inspiration, and joy back to shopping by making TikTok the leading, on-trend commerce platform of choice for brands, creators, and shoppers. We are an entrepreneurial team, passionate about shaping the future of shopping. The TikTok Shop US operation team aims to deliver high quality products together with a unique customer experience via TikTok. The team is responsible for building the TikTok Ecommerce partnership for the TikTok e-commerce business in the US. With more than 1 billion loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join us to build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users together. We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth. Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals. Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.ResponsibilitiesAcquire and incubate merchants to support category growth.Discover innovative collaborative models that align with merchants' short-term and long-term development plans, and invest platform resources effectively and efficiently.Solve key challenges in business growth by strong collaboration with cross-functional teams.Employ a consultative approach by offering strategic content, creator/affiliate/agency partner, merchandising, and logistical solutions to all clientsUpdate clients on TikTok Shop product developments and new promotional opportunitiesQualificationsMinimum Qualifications:Currently pursuing a MBA DegreeAble to commit to working for 12 weeks during Summer 2027Quick learner, proactive and resilient. Ability to thrive in ambiguity and adjust fast to change.Structured thinking, good data sense, very strong analytical skillsExcellent communication and cross-team collaboration, skilled at moving things forward.Passion for business and aim for higher goals.Preferred Qualifications:Internship or full-time experience in an e-commerce marketplace business, or retail category management is a plusFamiliarity with TikTok content ecosystem, shoppable content, and brand-creator partnerships is a plusCompensationThe hourly rate range for this position in the selected city is $38 - $38.Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Interns have day one access to health insurance, life insurance, wellbeing benefits and more. Interns also receive 10 paid holidays per year and paid sick time (56 hours if hired in first half of year, 40 if hired in second half of year). Interns who are not working 100% remote may also be eligible for housing allowance.The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.Los Angeles County (unincorporated) CandidatesQualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; andExercising sound judgment.About TikTokTikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.Why Join UsInspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.Diversity & InclusionTikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.TikTok AccommodationTikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

jobs.title: Media Studio Intern at KEEN Footwear
jobs.description: Employer: KEEN Footwear Expires: 12/03/2026 Are you passionate about sandals, boots, and everything in between? Do you live and breathe sustainability? Do you have a creative eye, a hunger to learn, and a KEEN interest in the outdoor industry? If you said yes to any of the above, we have the perfect opportunity for you!Position: Media Studio InternLocation: KEEN’s Global Headquarters in Portland, Oregon (on-site)Duration: 10 weeksCompensation: $22/hourProgram Duration: Monday, June 14th – Friday, August 20thWhat You'll DoAs an Intern at KEEN (KEENtern), you’ll dive into the exciting world of footwear, innovation, and community! You’ll get hands-on experience working alongside industry experts and contribute to shaping the future of KEEN.The Media Studio Intern will be hands-on in the studio where multiple projects across multiple sets are live daily. They will play an integral role in the execution of photography and video shoots that provide the visual marketing assets for KEEN Fan’s to engage with the product visually throughout the company’s channels including. Essential ResponsibilitiesCurrently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor’s degree in photography, journalism, art, film or a related field Must be enrolled in an accredited college or university at the Junior, Senior, or Graduate level. You will also be considered if you have recently graduated from an accredited college or university.Must be able to work 40 hours/week during the internship program during normal working hours (Monday–Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM) and be available to work in the office 5 days/week.Basic working knowledge of dslr/mirrorless camera systems (KEEN utilizes Canon and Fujifilm Cameras).Experience in a photo/video studio environment and/or production experience.Familiarity with strobe and continuous studio lighting a plus.Minimum QualificationsCurrently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor’s degree in Photography, Journalism, Art, Film or a related field.Must be enrolled in an accredited college or university at the Junior, Senior, or Graduate level. You will also be considered if you have recently graduated from an accredited college or university.Must be able to work 40 hours/week during the internship program during normal working hours (Monday–Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM) and be available to work in the office 5 days/week.Basic working knowledge of dslr/mirrorless camera systems (Keen utilizes Canon and Fujifilm Cameras).Experience in a photo/video studio environment and/or production experience.Familiarity with strobe and continuous studio lighting a plus.What We’re Looking For:We’re seeking someone who embodies our passion for creativity, sustainability, and the great outdoors. Our ideal KEENtern is:Passionate: Whether you’re an outdoor enthusiast, committed to sustainability, or fascinated by footwear trends and innovation, you’re excited to engage with the world around you.Creatively Minded: You’re detail-oriented, love bringing fresh ideas to life, and have a knack for solving problems.A Strong Communicator: Whether it’s collaborating with a team or presenting ideas, you know how to express yourself clearly and effectively.Proactive & Eager to Learn: You’re curious, ready to ask questions, take initiative, and dive into new challenges with enthusiasm.Why Intern with Us?Being a KEENtern means you’re not just an intern—you’re a valued part of our KEEN community. Here’s what you can look forward to:Meaningful Work: Tackle real-world projects that make an impact, gaining valuable hands-on experience at a globally recognized brand.Collaborative Environment: Partner with talented teammates and work on a group project with other KEENterns.Networking Opportunities: Build connections with industry experts and mentors who can help shape your career.Perks & Benefits: Enjoy product discounts, a subsidized cafeteria, and an inspiring workspace.Outdoor Adventures: Immerse yourself in Portland – a vibrant city nestled between the mountains and the coast – a hub for all things outdoors, such as hiking, biking, rafting, camping, and climbing.Program Requirements:To qualify for this internship, you must:Be a Junior, Senior, or Graduate student working toward a degree in Product Development, Footwear or Apparel Design, Product Management, Manufacturing, or a related field.Be eligible to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.Commit to a 10-week program from mid-June through mid-August. Dedicate 40 hours per week during standard M-F work week. This is an onsite role located at our beautiful headquarters office in Portland, OR.Plan no more than four total days of vacation during the internship. Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, including Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint. Able to learn and adapt quickly to new software and tools.Demonstrate strong verbal and written communication skills, strong attention to detail in preparation of presentations, reports, and materials.Demonstrate strong organization skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks. Proven ability to work independently as well as collaborate with a team.Able to perform the essential functions of the role, with or without reasonable accommodation, including using a computer for extended periods. jobs.description: Employer: Outback Deck Inc. Expires: 12/04/2026 Ready to build a real career and not just take a job?Outback Deck is one of Georgia’s premier outdoor living companies, known for exceptional craftsmanship and a culture that develops winners. Based in Woodstock, GA, we don’t just build beautiful decks, we build high-performing sales professionals. For two consecutive years, we’ve been named a Best Place to Work. Why? Because we believe our people are an investment — not an expense. We are looking for a sharp, autonomous student to help us build our direct sales pipeline.The RoleThis is not a "coffee delivery" internship. You will be working directly with our leadership as well as Dunkin’s corporate team to build a modern B2B sales engine from scratch. Your mission is to develop a network of institutional catering customers in areas proximate to our stores. You will leverage cutting-edge AI prospecting tools to identify, message, and close corporate partnerships with tech firms, professional offices, pharma reps, educational institutions, and hospital floor managers.Key ResponsibilitiesAI-Powered Prospecting: Utilize generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) and sales databases to automate and personalize hyper-local B2B outreach. Develop an AI-driven email outreach program targeting potential catering customers in areas proximate to our stores.Account Optimization: Ensure our menu interfaces are optimized for corporate “Bundles" and bulk-order options.What We Are Looking ForThe Hustle: A current student (BU, BC, Northeastern, Suffolk, or similar) studying Business, Hospitality, Tech, or Entrepreneurship.Tech Fluency: You already use AI tools to accelerate your workflow and know how to prompt effectively for professional copywriting and data sorting.Local Navigation: You know the layout of our markets.Autonomy: You love a role where you aren't micro-managed. Store and customer visits may involve exposure to varying weather conditions and typical retail and food-service environments.Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) StatementWatermark Donut Company, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.description: Employer: The Brave Women's Community Theatre Expires: 12/04/2026 Development, Fundraising & Community Partnerships InternshipSpring Semester (January 2027 – May 2027)Location: Lakewood, Colorado (Hybrid) | Hours: Approximately 8–10 hours per week (flexible) | Compensation: $300 stipend Help Build Something That MattersJoin a growing nonprofit dedicated to helping women heal from interpersonal abuse through creativity, connection, and community. This internship offers a unique opportunity to help build the foundation of an organization making a meaningful impact in the lives of survivors while gaining hands-on experience in nonprofit development, fundraising, community partnerships, and organizational growth. About The Brave Women's Community CenterThe Brave Women's Community Center (BWCC) is a Colorado nonprofit that provides trauma-informed, evidence-informed creative and relational programming for women who have experienced interpersonal abuse. Through expressive arts, storytelling, peer support, and community-centered programming, BWCC helps women rebuild self-trust, strengthen resilience, and create meaningful connections. As a growing nonprofit, BWCC offers interns the opportunity to make a tangible impact while gaining hands-on experience in nonprofit leadership, fundraising, community partnerships, and organizational development. Our MissionThe Brave Women's Community Center supports women who have experienced interpersonal abuse by providing trauma-informed, evidence-informed creative and relational programming. Through expressive arts, peer-based support, and structured group experiences, we help participants recognize harmful patterns, rebuild self-trust, and strengthen resilience. Our work complements crisis intervention and clinical services by offering restorative, preventative spaces where women can foster connection, reclaim their agency, and build the foundation for long-term healing. About the InternshipThe Development, Fundraising & Community Partnerships Intern will work closely with the Executive Director to help strengthen the long-term sustainability of The Brave Women's Community Center. This position is ideal for a student interested in nonprofit leadership, fundraising, business development, marketing, or community engagement who wants meaningful, hands-on experience helping a mission-driven organization grow.The intern will assist in identifying funding opportunities, cultivating community partnerships, researching prospective donors and sponsors, and supporting fundraising initiatives that expand BWCC's impact throughout Colorado. ResponsibilitiesThe Development, Fundraising & Community Partnerships Intern may assist with:Researching prospective individual donors, corporate sponsors, and foundations that align with BWCC's missionBuilding and organizing donor, sponsor, and community partner prospect listsResearching grant opportunities and assisting with grant preparationIdentifying speaking opportunities, conferences, networking events, and community outreach opportunitiesAssisting with sponsorship packages for programs, events, and the Brave Hearts Speak podcastSupporting Colorado Gives campaigns and other fundraising initiativesResearching employer matching gift programs and donor-advised fund opportunitiesHelping develop outreach materials, donor communications, and partnership presentationsAssisting in organizing fundraising strategies and relationship management systemsParticipating in community meetings, networking events, and partnership development as appropriateContributing ideas that strengthen BWCC's long-term sustainability and community impact Preferred QualificationsIdeal majors include:Business AdministrationMarketingNonprofit ManagementEntrepreneurshipCommunicationsPublic RelationsManagementFinanceSalesOr a related fieldStudents from other majors with a passion for nonprofit work, community impact, and social change are encouraged to apply. What You'll GainThis internship offers an opportunity to:Gain meaningful experience in nonprofit leadership and organizational developmentLearn about fundraising strategy, donor engagement, and community partnershipsBuild professional communication and relationship-building skillsDevelop experience with grant research, sponsorships, and nonprofit sustainabilityWork directly with the Executive Director of a growing nonprofitBuild a portfolio of real-world nonprofit development projectsMake a meaningful impact in the lives of women recovering from interpersonal abuse About the FounderLucia Severtson, MA, LPC, R-DMT, is the Founder and Executive Director of The Brave Women's Community Center. She is a Licensed Professional Counselor and Registered Dance/Movement Therapist with nearly two decades of experience working with women recovering from trauma, anxiety, OCD, and interpersonal abuse. Lucia is passionate about combining evidence-based mental health practices with creativity, storytelling, movement, theatre, and community to foster healing. She is also the host of the Brave Hearts Speak podcast, where survivors share their stories of resilience to inspire hope and healing in others. How to ApplyPlease submit the following:ResumeCover Letter describing your interest in BWCC's mission and this internshipEmail: Lucia@bravewomenscommunity.comSubject Line: Development Internship Application – Your Name

jobs.description: Employer: Invesco Expires: 12/05/2026 About Invesco As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. This reflects our belief that spending time together in the office helps us build stronger relationships, collaborate more easily, and support each other’s growth and development.The above information on this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this role. jobs.title: College Co-op MSD Wastewater Engineering (GIS/Acoustic Sound/LiDar) at City of Cincinnati
jobs.description: Employer: City of Cincinnati - Metropolitan Sewer District Expires: 12/05/2026 MSD WASTEWATER ENGINEERING - (GIS/Acoustic Sound/LiDar) Mission: Learn the value of data collection and its applicability to industrial uses, as well as the limitations and challenges of budget and time constraints. Tackle through a hands-on experience, the philosophical question of how to balance the cost to obtain information and its quality vs. the value it provides.Purpose: Develop tools to improve response time and reduce costs for data collection related to infrastructure. Apply applications to sensors and micro-computers which can be used in the field to take measurements. If time permits, work on ArcMap GIS applications and develop Python routines to automate desired, repetitive tasks performed by MSD users. Overview: Work as part of a team in a professional engineering environment. Develop communication skills both with engineers as well as maintenance staff. Learn about sewer infrastructure and the factors that affect its performance. Learn about data collection and analysis and its applicability to civil engineering and sewer design. Assume responsibility for ethical action and work production.Expectations: There are 4 primary tasks which the co-op may be expected to learn, understand and master: Work on developing an acoustic system for detecting stormwater pipe connection to MSDGC’s sewers. This work may include researching and recommending hardware, using hardware, coding, data collection, analysis, and field work. Work on refining LiDAR data collection and analysis to create 3D point clouds, and modifiable renderings with measurable dimensions of MSD infrastructure or environments affecting MSD sewer performance. The work may require changing or refining existing software applications already developed by MSD. Working with microcomputers, controllers, and sensors, as well as some basic fabrication is expected. 3D printing and related modeling are also anticipated. Finally, field work and testing of devices is likely.Work on the application of artificial intelligence (AI) to analyze collected data from acoustic testing, LiDAR, flow meters, or other datasets. This work may also involve developing an AI tool to assist with archiving paper records and automating the transfer of data into searchable databases.Use ArcGIS to log data and perform regional analysis. The four tasks are dependent on the needs of MSD during the period of the co-op and are likely to be uneven in the distribution of time spent per task.Co-op Learning Deliverables: Dependent on MSD needs and as time permits, the co-op is to deliver:-Advances in effective acoustic testing methods for MSD.-Advances in MSD’s LiDAR data collection.-Advances in the use of AI for MSD’s data analysis and archiving of paper records.-Updates to GIS mapping of MSD infrastructure. MSD to provide:-Budget: desktop or laptop computer, micro-computers, controllers, LiDAR units, movement tracking sensors, acoustic equipment, safety gear for field work, AI development tools, co-op compensation.-Logistics: workstation is in MSD’s WEEC (engineering) Building.-Training: training on city policies, rules, regulations. Milestones Orientation (week #1) Needs Assessment (week #2) Begin Project Work (weeks #1 - 3) Project Manager and co-op will work together to defines projects and timelines that ensures that project goals and objectives will be achieved. The projects will be tailored to suit the student’s interests and abilities. Continuation of Project Work(weeks #4 - 14) Investigate solutions, gather information from various sources, and work as necessary to complete project deliverables as well as possible additional ideas on project solutions. Perform mid-term review of project schedule and timeline at week #8. Make necessary adjustments to meet project objectives and project manager’s expectations. Prepare Final Documentation and Report Out (weeks #15 - 16) Conclude projects, where possible. Provide documentation and discuss with necessary parties to enable continuation of unfinished work. Summarize and evaluate lessons learned. Education Requirements: The applicant must currently be a college student at the time of applying, with successful completion of college classes in computer science or engineering. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to author or work with Python code and analyze large volumes of data, applying math and science. Below, a more detailed list of desired skillsets is provided. Required:Familiarity with Fourier transforms.Familiarity with wave functions.An understanding of wave propagation, and the differences between light vs. sound waves.Collect, process, and export large datasets and using trigonometric functions.Completion, as a minimum, Calculus I with an overall grade of “A-”, or better (or equivalent).A collegiate math and science cumulative GPA of 3.4, (on a 4.0, unweighted scale), or better.Familiarity with Linux as well as Microsoft operating systems, environments, and parameters.Familiarity with computer blogs, or other computer science community resources.Resourcefulness in finding solutions when sensors fail to communicate or work as intended. Desired, but not required: Ability to utilize artificial intelligence and algorithms for use with analyzing video imagery.Familiarity with electronics and power requirements including resistance, voltage, and amperage.Experience tutoring or teaching.Familiarity with 3D printing.Familiarity with Esri ArcMap.Ability to code in Python.Familiarity with the application of AI and developing application tools with AI.Ability to set up environments on micro-computers and install peripheral devices for sensing and data collection which can communicate with the micro-computer and the code written by the applicant.Ability to set up Linux operating systems on micro-computers, then install and run Python code.Ability to import and export large datasets across a micro-computer vs. more powerful computing platform (desktop or laptop computer)Use of Python and math to create intuitive, easily discernible, yet accurate and informative visual representation of coordinate (x,y,z) data clouds. HR Contact: Jerrold Ware, Jerrold.Ware@cincinnati-oh.gov

jobs.title: Activision 2027 Summer Internships - Tech Art at Activision Blizzard
jobs.description: Employer: Activision Blizzard - Activision Expires: 12/05/2026 Activision is looking for talented and innovative students to join our teams for summer 2027. All interns will receive a meaningful project and an unparalleled experience. We’ll provide the tools and resources you need to learn. The challenging and creative work you do throughout your internship will directly impact the team you are contributing to. All internships will be conducted in-person. Hosting managers will determine when and how often interns work in the office. All interns will have the option to opt into relocation services (flights, trains, or car mileage reimbursement). Additionally, all interns will be provided with a living stipend to subsidize housing, utility, commuting, and miscellaneous costs. Program Requirements Currently enrolled in a certificate, associate’s, bachelor’s, or master’s degree program and graduating May 2027 – June 2028 Available to participate in a 12-week internship starting in mid-May or mid-June Currently residing in the US or open to relocating oneself to the US Exhibits learning agility; has the ability to think differently, and/or grasp and apply new skills and concepts Approaches problems in a clear, well-organized, and solutions-oriented manner Works well with others and contributes to team tasks Able to effectively communicate problems, solutions, needs, or priorities Is engaged, seeks to learn, and is able to manage time effectively A passion for significantly impacting game development Applicants must apply with a resume and portfolio, reel, or Git repository to be considered Internship Opportunities Tech Art Intern: As a Technical Artist, you will utilize your creative problem-solving abilities across a wide range of technical solutions. You'll collaborate with artists and engineers to help improve and expand upon content creation pipelines and tool sets. Requirements: Skilled with 3D applications such as Maya, Blender, ZBrush, Substance, etc. (Houdini, MetaHuman, MotionBuilder, or Speedtree are a plus). Experience with Unity, Unreal, or other game engines. Knowledge of coding language such as Python, Java, C# or C++ and object-oriented programming practices. Understanding of production/tracking tools (Jira, Perforce, etc.) Strong traditional art foundation and technical problem-solving abilities. Enthusiasm for participating in the critique process and ability to execute on feedback. Portfolio/reel or Git repository demonstrating tech art related projects (Destruction, tools, rigging, TD work, etc.) Hosting Locations: Activision Motion Capture Studio (Playa Vista, CA) & Raven Software (Middleton, WI) Our World At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences. We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization. We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up. Ready to Activate Your Future? The video game industry and therefore our business is fast-paced and will continue to evolve. As such, the duties and responsibilities of this role may be changed as directed by the Company at any time to promote and support our business and relationships with industry partners. We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply. We are committed to working with and providing reasonable assistance to individuals with physical and mental disabilities. If you are a disabled individual requiring an accommodation to apply for an open position, please email your request to accommodationrequests@activisionblizzard.com. General employment questions cannot be accepted or processed here. Thank you for your interest. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, among other characteristics.

jobs.description: Employer: Watts Water Technologies Expires: 12/06/2026 We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water.We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support -- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource. What we do:For 150 years, Watts has built best-in-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead.​ Scope of Position Motivated and curious Product Manager Co‑op to join our team and help shape the future of our products. In this role, you’ll collaborate with cross‑functional partners, contribute to product strategy, and support the delivery of features that solve real customer problems. This is an excellent opportunity to learn how product decisions are made and how, products come to life, and how products need to be supported during their lifecycle. The Co-op Product Manager role, under guidance from the Product Manager, plays a role in managing the performance, and lifecycle of assigned product lines through end-of-life cycle to drive optimize profit, sales and brand objectives. This position reports to the Product Manager. This position is based in Menomonee Falls, WI. This is a full time co-op January - June 2027. Primary Job Duties and ResponsibilitiesAssist in defining product requirements and success metrics.Conduct market, customer, and competitive research to inform product decisions.Analyze user feedback and usage data to identify opportunities for improvement.Support the creation of product documentation, user stories, and acceptance criteria.Work closely with engineering, design, and QA to ensure smooth feature development.Gather and synthesize customer insights through interviews, surveys, and analytics.Monitor product performance and help identify trends or issues.Maximization of performance of product line(s) as measured via orders / sales growth, profitability and cash-flow generation.Adherence to product line base cost and margin targets.Manage SKU rationalization and line harvesting.Works with sales and marketing team to develop and refine the product line go to market strategy.Create and/ or support the creation of training materials and lead training sessions to educate customers and sales personnel on product technical features and benefits.Involvement in other projects as assigned. Required Qualifications Currently pursuing a degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field.Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn.Must write clearly, informatively, and logically, and have the ability to vary writing style to meet the needs of the audience.Outstanding interpersonal skills with an emphasis on building strong team relationships.Proactive, creative work style and a self-starter.Proficient computer skills (Microsoft Office suite) required. General Applicable Company Competencies Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency.Punctuality and dependability.Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions.Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts.Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees.Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action. Working Conditions: While performing the job duties, you will be working on-site at a manufacturing facility and will perform the majority of your duties in an office environment. You may, at times, be required to be present on the manufacturing floor and will be required to wear the appropriate personal protective equipment. You will be required to work in the office at the Bradley location (Monday – Friday). Your scheduled work hours will be communicated to you by your manager. Physical Requirements: Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to:Ability to remain seated at a desk or workstation for extended periods.Ability to perform repetitive tasks like typing on a keyboard or using a mouse for extended periods.Ability to physically move around the office, organize or transport files, packages, or other office-related materials.Ability to occasionally lift and carry light objects, such as office supplies, documents, or small equipment. Nothing in this job description restricts Watts’ right to assign or reassign duties, responsibilities, and working hours/conditions to this position at any time. This position is “at will,” which means that either the employee or Watts may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason. #LI (Onsite) Watts in it for you: Please note that the following benefits apply only to permanent roles and do not apply to internship roles.Competitive compensation based on your skills, qualifications and experienceComprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefitsFamily building benefits, including paid maternity/paternity leave10 paid holidays and Paid Time OffContinued professional development opportunities and educational reimbursementAdditional perks such as fitness reimbursements and employee discount programsLearn more about our benefit offerings here: https://tapintowattsbenefits.com/ How we work:At Watts, our culture is team-oriented and supportive. Employees here genuinely care about the quality of their work, and about each other. Our people are the heart of who we are and contribute to our longevity and continued success. And this is a place where you can have a big career. No matter your role, there are opportunities for learning and development, and your daily contributions make a meaningful impact on the lives of people who use our products and on the future of water. Watts is committed to equal employment opportunity. We follow a policy of administering all employment decisions and personnel actions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, national origin, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, genetic disposition or carrier status, marital status, military or veteran status, minorities, or any other category protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Project Management Intern (Hybrid) at Clark Associates, Inc.
jobs.description: Employer: Clark Associates, Inc. Expires: 12/06/2026 Job SummarySpend Your Summer Making an Impact Are you the person who always asks "Why do we do it that way?" and then starts thinking of a better way? Clark National Accounts, a division of Clark Associates, is looking for a Project Management Intern to join our Project Services team for the summer. This isn't a coffee-running internship. You'll get hands-on exposure to how large-scale restaurant and retail projects come to life while owning real process improvement initiatives that help our team work smarter as we continue to grow. If you're curious, driven, love solving problems, and want to see how a fast-paced business operates behind the scenes, we'd love to meet you. Who Are We? Clark National Accounts partners with some of the largest restaurant, retail, entertainment, healthcare, hospitality, and senior living brands in the country. We help our customers successfully open new locations by providing equipment, supplies, project management, logistics coordination, and operational expertise. Our Project Services team has a unique opportunity to collaborate with customers, warehouses, installers, account managers, analysts, and many other teams to turn plans into reality. As an intern, you'll get a behind-the-scenes look at how all those pieces work together.Job LocationHybrid: Some in-person work required.30 Citation Lane, Lititz, PA 17543We only accept W-2 candidates, H-1B sponsorship is not available.ResponsibilitiesWhat You'll Do Throughout the summer, you'll participate in a structured rotation across multiple areas of our Project Services organization, gaining exposure to different functions and learning how each contributes to the success of our customers. Team Rotations You'll spend time learning from and working alongside team members supporting: Restaurant & Retail Projects Commercial & Non-Commercial Projects Installation Projects Prospective Customer Solutions You'll attend meetings, shadow team members, learn our systems and processes, and gain exposure to how projects move from concept to customer opening. Own Meaningful Projects You'll also take ownership of process improvement initiatives that directly support team efficiency, scalability, and operational excellence. You'll work closely with team leaders and stakeholders to: Understand existing processes Analyze data Identify improvement opportunities Develop recommendations Implement solutions Present your results and impact What You'll Learn By the end of the summer, you'll gain exposure to: Project management fundamentals Process improvement strategies Data analysis and reporting Cross-functional business operations Foodservice and restaurant development Professional communication and stakeholder management Business systems and operational tools You'll also have opportunities for professional development, including: Leadership and team meetings Cross-department shadowing experiences Vendor and customer-facing training sessions Store and kitchen visits Networking opportunities throughout the organization Access to Clark Associates Internship Development Program and networking with peers Physical RequirementsWork is performed while sitting/standing and interfacing with a personal computer.Requires the ability to communicate effectively using speech, vision, and hearing.Requires the regular use of hands for simple grasping and fine manipulations.Requires occasional bending, squatting, crawling, climbing, and reaching.Requires the ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull medium weights, up to 50lbs.QualificationsExperienceWhat We're Looking For We're looking for someone who is: Currently a junior pursuing a bachelor's degree and returning for their senior year Curious and eager to learn Self-motivated and loves to take initiative Excited to solve problems and improve processes Comfortable working with data and technology Organized and detail-oriented An effective communicator Adaptable in a fast-paced environment Interested in how businesses scale and operate EducationThis role does not require a degree. We value relevant skills and experience and alignment with our core values above all else.Desired Traits & SkillsBonus Points If You Have: Experience in the foodservice, restaurant, retail, hospitality, or customer service industries Experience using data to drive process improvements Leadership experience through clubs, athletics, work, or campus organizations Previous internship experience Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're much more interested in curiosity, work ethic, and a willingness to learn. Why This Internship? Because you'll leave with more than a line on your résumé. You'll gain exposure to a growing business, work on projects that make a measurable impact, build relationships with leaders across the organization, and develop skills that will help you regardless of where your career takes you. Most importantly, you'll spend your summer working on real business challenges alongside a team that values new ideas and fresh perspectives. Location Hybrid: We believe in building strong team connections through in-person collaboration, while maintaining the flexibility of remote work. This position is located in our Lititz office (30 Citation Lane, Lititz, PA 17543), with two in-office days per week. Travel Occasional local travel for store visits, vendor events, or company meetings may occur during the internship. Looking to Stand Out? In your application or cover letter, tell us: What's a process you've improved, challenged, or rethought, and what made you want to change it? We love hearing from people who look at the way things are and imagine how they could be better. Hiring ProcessQualified applicants will be contacted for a phone interview and then may continue to 1 or 2 additional rounds of in-person or virtual interviews. Applicants will receive a point of contact and email confirmation of the next steps at each stage of the interview process.

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. Access to mental health resources including counseling sessions. More details about eligibility for this assistance will be provided at the time of offer. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need.Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work from Universal City, CA.Summer 2027 Recruitment TimelineNovember 9 – December 4: Applications Open (may close early due to applicant volume)Mid November – Late December: First round video interviewsMid – Late January: Second round interviewsLate January – February: Selected candidates receive offersTo Apply:Submit a one-page resume that outlines your work experience, accomplishments, and your graduation month and year. Submit a cover letter that highlights your passion for NBCUniversal and your top areas of interest (opportunities listed below). Upload a transcript (unofficial transcripts are fine) that confirms your status as an actively enrolled student in a degree-granting program. Franchise, Products & Partnerships extends NBCUniversal’s iconic brands, characters and stories through global consumer products and games, theme park merchandise and retail, in addition to the UDX enterprise function of franchise management and strategic partnerships. Supporting NBCUniversal’s owned portfolio of properties as well as third-party partners across the theme park business, FPP creates products, experiences and partnerships that deepen fandom and connects audiences around the world with the characters, stories and worlds that define Universal.​Areas of placement may include, but are not limited to:Franchise Creative: this intern will help bring characters and worlds to life through illustration, concept development, and visual storytelling. This intern will conduct visual research, review character-based products, and help organize project artwork. The ideal candidate is proficient in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, has a strong understanding of character design, anatomy, and perspective, and brings a versatile visual development skill set along with an interest in animation and storytelling. Toys & Hardlines: this intern will help create exciting product and packaging experiences through market research, creative ideation, and innovative design. This intern will develop packaging concepts and structures, create sketches, Illustrator artwork, and mood boards to support toy strategies, and contribute to branding and packaging development using established style guides and IP guidelines. Working alongside internal and external cross-functional teams, partners, and vendors, this intern will also research consumer insights, global toy trends, and the competitive landscape while supporting projects throughout the product development process. Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from NBCUniversal now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States. Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7 – August 13, 2027. Must be willing to work in Universal City, CA. For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without NBCUniversal sponsorship.NBCUniversal is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.Desired Characteristics:Students with class standing of junior or above preferred. Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above. Proficient in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop. Ability to communicate ideas clearly through sketches and presentations. Skilled in CS Suite, 3D software and all relevant software for product design & development including Keynote for presentations. Have a broad understanding of character design and development. Strong understanding of anatomy and perspective. jobs.title: 2027 AKS Marketing Internship Program at AKS Engineering & Forestry LLC
jobs.description: Employer: AKS Engineering & Forestry LLC - AKS Expires: 12/10/2026 Go Beyond the Classroom Looking to build real-world experience this summer? The AKS Internship Program gives college students the chance to apply what they’re learning in the classroom, build practical skills, and contribute in a professional environment. Through meaningful project experience and a supportive team setting, interns gain confidence, broaden their understanding of the industry, and take important steps toward career readiness. How it WorksEach internship experience may look a little different depending on the role and team, but every internship is designed to help students learn by doing. Interns gain hands-on experience through real work, connect with professionals across AKS, and get a better understanding of how different disciplines contribute to project outcomes. For students who return, each summer can build on the last with new experiences, added responsibility, and a deeper understanding of areas that interest them. Participation is a one-summer commitment at a time. Students who are interested in returning are encouraged to express interest, and continued participation depends on performance, program fit, and available positions. Who You AreTo be considered for this internship program, students should: Be currently enrolled in an accredited 2- or 4-year program with a declared major in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or similar. Have completed at least one year of college before the internship start date Maintain a GPA of 3.0 or higher Be available to work full-time for 12 weeks during the summer Be able to work from the Tualatin, OR, or Vancouver, WA, office, where this program is offered Have working knowledge of design and visual content tools, including Adobe Illustrator, Adobe InDesign, Canva, and CapCut. What You’ll LearnBring Your Coursework to Life: Take what you learned in class and apply it to hands-on experiences. Understand Proposals: Establish an understanding of what goes into successful proposals that win jobs in the AEC industry. Develop Technical and Creative Skills: Grow your skills in strategic communication, design layout fundamentals, and social media planning/analytics. Day in the Life (Examples)The program includes two tracks: Business Development and Communications. Students are assigned to one of these tracks based on team needs and program fit. Business Development Track (Tualatin, OR or Vancouver, WA) Work under the direction of a Senior Proposal Manager and alongside the Business Development team to gain hands-on experience in a client-focused, results-driven consulting environment. Interns can expect to work approximately 40 hours per week. Responsibilities may include: Supporting proposal development through completing research and producing compelling graphics Assisting in resume preparation and content writing Applying design skills to proposals and award submittals Communications Track (Tualatin, OR only) Work under the direction of a Communications Lead and alongside the Communications team to gain hands-on experience in a client-focused consulting environment. Interns can expect to work approximately 40 hours per week. Responsibilities may include: Assisting with website, blog, newsletter, and social media content Drafting, editing, and proofreading internal and external communications materials Assisting with brand consistency across communications and collateral We Have Your Back At AKS, interns are supported throughout the summer. Each intern is paired with a mentor and receives direction from a supervisor who guides assignments and project work. That supervisor may vary depending on the projects involved. Throughout the internship, interns receive regular feedback to support learning, growth, and professional development. At the end of the summer, each intern participates in a final evaluation to reflect on their experience, discuss future goals, and explore the possibility of returning for another internship, based on performance and available openings. Earn While You Learn This is a paid internship, and interns are compensated for their time and contributions. Pay is provided on an hourly basis, with overtime paid at one and a half times the regular rate for hours worked over 40 in a week. The typical pay range for this position is $19 to $25 per hour. Time off may be requested in advance, but it is unpaid.
